about_the_game:
Game Summary

Walls everywhere, bombs flying, absolute chaos... sound like a dream? Well, it's not anymore! Atomic Blastman is here, and it’s a modern, souped-up remake of that legendary 1997 bomb-blasting hit.

Get ready to blast through blocks, trick your rivals, and just try to stay alive as the whole map explodes around you. Play alone, or dive into huge online matches with tons of players across awesome modes like Classic or Battle Royale.

Features

  • New powerups and updated game mechanics.

  • Full customization for the entire game, including arenas, skins, emotes, icons, banners, game themes, player intros, and much more.

  • Fully customizable levels using an in-game arena editor.

  • Both singleplayer and online multiplayer modes are available.

  • Introducing a new arena sudden death mechanic.

  • Be the last player standing to win the round. The first player to win all rounds wins the match and earns a random powerup for the start of their next game.

  • Each game gives you XP, which can be spent in the in-game store. The store also includes microtransactions.

  • AI bots use a neural network to try and outperform players. These bots can live train, constantly getting better and better.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (4 cores / 4-8 threads)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 (or equivalent) / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X (6 cores / 12 threads)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (8 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Ready for chaos? Play solo or in massive multiplayer matches across modes like Classic, Battle Royale, and more. Build custom levels using the in-game editor, deck out your character with skins and emotes, and face off against AI that actually learns. Jump in and start blasting!
